_DevKestrelNote: The Http endpoint below is deliberately only defined here, not in appsettings.json - that file is also loaded in Production, and ASP.NET Core's config providers merge by key rather than letting a later layer's Https-only Kestrel block replace an earlier layer's Http one. Keeping this dev-only convenience out of the shared base file is what makes 'Production requires HTTPS' actually mean HTTPS-only in Production, not HTTPS-plus-still-open-HTTP.
